stages.reference: Study the slight imperfections of aged cyan stained glass without changing the appearance established by its companion pane. Show a few hair-fine optical ripples, very small air seeds and quiet variations in mineral pigment density; keep them faint enough to dissolve into translucent aqua material. The sense of craft comes from restrained thickness changes, not decorative drawing or extreme sharpness. Let the color stay between blue and green and allow the existing source alpha to govern the final detail regions. Avoid turning the material into waves, crystal ice, paint streaks, frosted opaque glass, etched patterns, strong bright lines or a filled background. This layer should gently deepen the existing cyan glass, not establish another surface design.
